standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T145119Z, recomputed 2026-10-18 after a fix to tools/issue.py. The BLS PPI, CPI and average-price series carry September 2026. Prose not yet written. tools/check.py --all passes for this issue. Correction recorded here because it changed the computed set: the Choice less Select cutout year-over-year change was printed in numbers.md and never stored in numbers.json, so numbers.md asserted a figure the computed set did not hold and this issue failed the verification gate on the figure 28.5. compute_beef now stores yoy_pct for that measure and numbers_md_beef prints the stored value. The same row at the September baseline prints -6.5% and passed the gate only because that value happens to equal two unrelated stored figures, cutout_select trailing_4wk_yoy_pct and fed_cattle_dressed yoy_pct; that issue has not been recomputed, so its numbers.md still carries an unstored figure. Read the stored change with care: the measure is a difference between two cutouts, so a percentage change on it is sensitive when the spread is small and has no meaning if the spread crosses zero. Other gaps in this month's figures: the derived Choice cutout less fed cattle dressed price carries no prior-year figure, and its two legs are different weeks, the cutout week ending 2026-10-16 against the cattle week ending 2026-10-13. The NASS cattle-on-feed inventory is 2026-09 while placements and marketings are 2026-08, and none of the three carries a two-year comparison. The weekly cattle and beef summary is retained and not parsed, so it contributes no figure. Publication gated by FA-D-20260923-01 as amended by FA-D-20260923-02 and FA-D-20260923-04.
